lines.2: 「Didn't this round feel, like, especially hard?」
lines.3: 「Crab-chi, you say that every time, ne. Same as people saying this year's cold is especially nasty, ne.」
lines.7: 「I don't think defining your character with a verbal tic like that is a good idea, ne.」
lines.9: 「All right. Today went pretty well too.」
lines.12: Class C and Class A only had Class B between them.
lines.13: If we were both walking the halls, running into each other wasn't unusual.
lines.14: 「Judging by your face, looks like things went pretty well for you too.」
lines.17: 「That's what I was going to ask YOU.」
lines.18: 「I went out of my way to keep the day open, you know.」
lines.19: 「So what is it? Are you treating me to something?」
lines.22: 「And meet in front of Ryuumeikan Academy's gate at ten.」
lines.23: 「You're not planning to swim at school, are you?」
lines.24: 「No. The swim club would be using the pool anyway.」
lines.25: 「...Hmm. So the beach or a pool.」
lines.27: Truth was, I didn't really know what was going on either.
lines.28: Not like I could defy absolute authority.
